text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I'm stopping by the central
plaza, I
spot Inari One and Tamamo
Cross.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What's this? Cleats and textbooks?
What're these
doing 'round here?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Flea market, don'tcha think? Just look at
how
they're organized.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Go ahead and take them... if you'd like.
A loser
like me won't be needing them
anymore...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oh? Izzat so?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Don't be so hasty! How d'ya know you're
never
gonna wanna run again in the
future, eh?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Tama, c'mon,
ya gotta play it a li'l cooler
than
that. Don't force it.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Wait. That photo you've got there, was
it taken
during a race? You're givin' this
away too?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, a photo? I don't remember... Did I
mix it up
when I was organizing my
things?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Oh... This was when I won my first race.
What's it
doing here?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Look at the big ol' smile ya got there! I
knew
it—you do love raci—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well, ya don't need this no more! It'll
just hold ya
back!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna go toss this away for ya!
I'll be
back in a
jiffy!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huh, wh-what are you—W-w-wait up!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Come back, Inari! Return the girl's
photo!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Not a chance! This is going where it
belongs! If
you want it back, you'll have
to catch me!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Come on! Catch me if you can!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You just gonna sit there 'n let that idiot
run away?
She's serious, y'know?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Phew... Looks like they aren't on my tail anymore. I wonder if they gave up.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: WAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Haha! You'd scare a boiled
octopus back
to life with that face!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Now I'm having fun! Come at me! I'm so
ready for
a tussle!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaa... Haah... Hnnng...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Eager to retrieve her photo, the
Umamusume
makes a mad dash for Inari
One... before stopping
herself.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Why... Why?! I already made up
my mind to
quit...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Talk to me, how are you feeling?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to catch up so badly... Losing
was so, so
frustrating but... I still want to
win!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well, I think that settles it. Sounds like
you've got
some racin' to do.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Glad ya decided to give it another go!
And Inari,
nice goin'!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Just remember it's all uphill from here.
You're treadin' a thorny path of blood,
sweat, and tears.
But once you've
overcome it, let's tussle again!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Okay!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Looks like all's well that ends
well!
